01 / Independent project · iOS

Elite
Hypertrophy.

An iOS fitness application for workout routines, exercise and set logging, progress history, and social features.

01

Application scope

Built an iOS fitness app with workout routines, exercise and set logging, progress history, and user profiles. Social features include friends and posts.

The interface brings training records and workout history together so users can review their sessions over time.

02

Implementation

Developed the interface with SwiftUI and connected app features to a Supabase-backed data store.

Language
Swift
Interface
SwiftUI
Backend
Supabase
Beta distribution
Apple TestFlight
03

Testing & distribution

Distributed beta builds through Apple TestFlight and defined tests covering accounts, workouts, social features, and data persistence.
